subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 3 — product consolidations (review request)

question: Should an existing operator-configured remote-rescue deny remain a supported security contract after this consolidation, or may the product permanently replace it with fixed YOLO owner-DM rescue behavior?
rationale: The branch intentionally removes the only explicit rescue enable/deny setting, and source behavior makes the safe outcome depend on host posture rather than the prior operator decision; code review cannot safely choose that security-policy change.

options.title: Preserve explicit rescue denial
options.body: Keep a supported migration target that retains an operator's explicit remote-rescue opt-out while consolidating the remaining policy defaults.

options.title: Approve fixed owner-DM rescue
options.body: Accept removal of the opt-out and document that trusted YOLO owner-DM rescue is now a permanent built-in policy.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit rescue denial
recommendation.body: Keep a supported migration target that retains an operator's explicit remote-rescue opt-out while consolidating the remaining policy defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the policy-consolidation commits and explicitly presented the product decision for maintainer review.
